checks.claim: A swim bladder is a gas-filled organ that lets a bony fish control how it floats
checks.why: The swim bladder is an internal gas-filled organ that lets bony fish hold a depth without swimming; sharks and rays lack it.

checks.claim: Gill rakers are comb-like projections on the gill arches that keep particles away from the gill filaments
checks.why: Gill rakers on the gill arches keep solid particles off the soft gill filaments, and in filter feeders they hold food.

checks.claim: Fresh water holds about 14.6 milligrams of oxygen per liter at 0 degrees Celsius but only about 7.6 at 30 degrees
checks.why: Saturation tables give 14.6 milligrams per liter at 0 degrees and 7.56 to 7.65 at 30 degrees at sea level.

checks.claim: The lateral line is a sense organ that lets fish feel movements and vibrations in the water around them
checks.why: Neuromasts of the lateral line sense water movement and low-frequency vibration, used for hunting, avoiding predators and schooling.
